billing.title: Billing
billing.selfHosted: This server is self-hosted: there is nothing to pay. Set parallel runs below; the Admin sets member limits.
billing.planSub: The base plan includes 1 parallel run and {members} members.
billing.slotsHelp: Each extra run at once costs {price} a month. Adding one now charges the rest of this month from credits.
billing.slotsHelpSelfHosted: How many runs this workspace has at once, free on this server. Up to {max}; the server's AGNTS_MAX_SLOTS sets the limit.
billing.membersHelp: {included} included; each one more costs {price} a month.
billing.creditsSub: Runs on agnts's API key (the fallback) spend credits: 1 credit is $0.01 of Anthropic API cost. The month's plan is paid from them too.
billing.paymentsOff: Payments are not set up on this server yet; ask the Admin to grant credits.
billing.freeCreditsSub: From agnts. Runs on agnts's Muse key spend them before the workspace's credits.
billing.freeCreditsNone: None yet. An Admin can give you free credits for runs on agnts's Muse key.
billing.limitsSub: Set by an Admin for runs on agnts's Muse key. They reset on the 1st of each month.
billing.fallbackHint: {name} is the backup provider: your runs use it only while agnts's Meta access is out. When this is used up, they wait for Meta instead.
